stop: Requested age reached; 16 accepted intervals, none rejected.
outer_layer_model: Hydrostatic, homogeneous, constant-luminosity envelope; base-state heat and composition reservoir retained in the evolution equations.
initial_adjustment: The boundary was inserted near 3757 K. The insertion transient is not established to 0.1 percent accuracy. A fresh Hayashi calculation with the final boundary is required.
status: Development diagnostic. The integrated envelope, revised cold EOS and molecular-opacity tables are local research inputs; final boundary and full-lifetime validation remain unfinished.

molecular_absorption_update.prescription: CIA v2: HITRAN absolute (Abel 2011 H2-H2 T<=3000 K; Abel 2012 H2-He); Borysow 2001 H2-H2 >=4000 K; declared 3000-4000 K blend; partf at max(T,1000 K)
molecular_absorption_update.limitations: Some edge cells remain masked; native envelope coverage reaches about 2550–2600 K along the expected cooling corridor. Revised CIA is a physical correction, selected after a matched stellar comparison.

quantum_ion_assessment.scope: Offline first quantum-ion correction, assuming fully ionized point ions in a uniform neutralizing electron background. Not selected in the stellar EOS.
limitations: Partial ionization and electron screening modify the uniform-background approximation.
The all-charged versus neutral-metal comparison is a sensitivity estimate, not a full partial-ionization model.
Mass-integrated heat capacity is not a measured change in cooling age.
Baiko-Yakovlev 2019 treats one ion species; its use here only estimates higher-order size for helium.
Reuse the retained Baiko-Chugunov 2022 research before implementing deeper quantum cooling and melting.
